about.availableBody: The installer downloads first. Then Install and restart appears.

about.readyBody: Now install, and Atic restarts. The 100% earlier was only the file.
about.tagline: Record calls, transcribe, and summarize on your PC.
about.updatesHint: Looks at the latest GitHub release. First it downloads, then you install and restart.
hotkey.hint: Esc cancels. A side mouse button works too.

onboarding.autostartHint: Stays in the tray without opening this window.
onboarding.beepHint: An audible cue for everyone else.
onboarding.claim1: It never records on its own: you always decide.
onboarding.claim2: Audio stays on the PC when you transcribe locally.
onboarding.claim3: You can delete any recording whenever you want.
onboarding.coach.clipboardBody: Copy any text and press the shortcut. It should open next to the pill.
onboarding.coach.dictationBody: Press the shortcut, say a sentence, and release. The text should show up here.
onboarding.coach.wheelBody: Hold the shortcut. The wheel appears at the cursor. Release when you've seen it.
onboarding.consentBody: In many places —Chile included— recording a call needs the participants' consent. Use Atic only when it's allowed, and tell the others if you need to.
onboarding.dictationBody: Without a GPU, Groq dictates almost instantly. That short clip leaves your PC. Meetings transcribe on your machine by default; you can switch them to Groq in Meetings or Settings.
onboarding.modelsGroq: Meetings transcribe on your PC by default. This model is also a fallback if Groq doesn't respond.
onboarding.modelsLocal: Transcription runs on your PC. By default we download one fast model for dictation and meetings.
onboarding.nowPractice: Now let's practice next to the pill.
onboarding.pendingBytes: About {size} left to download. You can continue and do it later in Settings.
onboarding.permissionsBody: macOS asks you to let Atic hear you, paste where you type and see the screen. Without them dictation won't paste and screenshots come out empty. Granting them doesn't make Atic record on its own: it only uses them when you start a tool.
onboarding.restInSettings: The rest is in Settings → Shortcuts.
onboarding.setup.clipboard.hint: What you copied, ready to paste again.
onboarding.setup.clipboard.label: Clipboard history
onboarding.setup.dictation.hint: You speak and the text is pasted where you were.
onboarding.setup.dictation.label: Dictate
onboarding.setup.wheel.hint: Hold it and release over the tool.

onboarding.shortcutsBody: Three shortcuts, not ten. Confirm or change them now: you'll need them next.

onboarding.trayNote: Atic lives in the system tray: the X hides this window; it doesn't quit the app or stop a recording. To quit fully, use Quit in the tray menu.

onboarding.whisperNote: Whisper runs on the CPU. The next step downloads a small model.
